dataset.name: Romania's Danube bridge tolls (tarif de trecere)
dataset.method: Ordonanța Guvernului nr. 15/2002, art. 1 and Anexa nr. 3 (A2 bridges between Fetești and Cernavodă; DN2A bridge between Giurgeni and Vadu Oii), tariffs from 8 September 2025 (OG nr. 23/2025) as CNAIR publishes them: one crossing either way, category 2 (over 3.5 to under 12 t), 3 (12 t and over, up to 3 axles), 4 (4 axles or more), lei excluding 21% VAT. OG 15/2002 was repealed when TollRo started on 1 October 2026. The Giurgiu–Ruse bridge (towards Ruse only) isn't priced.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: CNAIR: Tabele ROVINIETA PEAJ (OG 23/2025), the Internet Archive's copy

vehicles.description: Trucks over 3.5 t, by mass and axles

network.description: The A2 Danube bridge at Cernavodă (with the Borcea bridge at Fetești, one ticket) and the DN2A Danube bridge at Giurgeni.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
